tracks.title: 바꿔 뿌려 봐
tracks.mood: playful, teasing, cosy; warm banter that ends in laughing relief
tracks.subject: For a year Sohee has held her breath in the heavy rose perfume Minjun gave her, while he dutifully wears the leathery cologne she picked and secretly hates; at their second-anniversary dinner both confess, swap bottles, and each scent suits its giver.
